name: Shizukura Isuzu
source:
Favorite: Miso soup
A shrine maiden who holds the position of Kanchō, the head priestess overseeing all Shinto affairs in Iseno. She is exceptionally serious and highly capable.
Since the Sai-Miko (Imperial Shrine Maiden) often resides at the Imperial Sanctuary in Tenkyo, she is responsible for managing Iseno, home to the largest shrine in the Imperial Nation.
She has been close friends with Kotone since their school days and recognizes her talent more than anyone else.
Though often exasperated by Kotone’s free-spirited nature—frequently scolding her and reining her in—at her core, she is committed to supporting Kotone to the very end.
